title: Automation cannot be enabled if action is notification and notification text is blank
body:
When entering new automation that triggers a notification, the UI does not indicate that it is mandatory to enter a notification message. In fact, when I first selected notification as an action type, I didn't even realize it was asking a message. If I leave the message empty, I can't enable the automation and there is no indication why it can't be enabled.

Suggestion: when the notification is first created, show an error message to the user if the message field is left empty. Or alternatively, fill in some template message so that user will not leave the field empty.

I was using 3.3.2.1 release tag for reproducing this issue.
